original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州警方追捕涉嫌用锤杀害父亲的男子
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州警方证实，执政党全体进步大会党（APC）一名地方负责人朱利叶斯·贝洛被其儿子伊罗布多杀害，据称凶手用大锤击打其头部。警方表示嫌疑人仍在逃，调查已经展开。有家庭消息人士称，嫌疑人周末从拉各斯返回家中，并于周日袭击了父亲。目前该案为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Fugar, Estako Central Local Government Area, Edo State

key_facts.fact: 埃多州警方证实APC地方负责人朱利叶斯·贝洛被其儿子伊罗布多杀害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Edo State Police Command on Monday confirmed the killing of a chieftain of the All Progressives Congress, Julius Bello, by his son, Irobudo.

key_facts.fact: 警方称嫌疑人仍在逃，调查已开始
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The police have commenced investigation into the matter, and the suspect is currently at large

key_facts.fact: 据称嫌疑人用大锤击打父亲头部致死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He was reportedly hacked to death by his son, who used a sledgehammer to hit him on the head.

key_facts.fact: 家庭消息人士称嫌疑人周末从拉各斯返回并于周日袭击父亲
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A family source said that the suspect returned home from Lagos at the weekend and attacked his father on Sunday

uncertainties: 嫌疑人作案动机（据称与关于贫困的预言有关）尚未获警方证实
嫌疑人仍在逃，尚未被捕
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
